scope: Known public const-folding proof reproduction; no new theorem, performance comparison, unseen test, or parent CS-001 completion.
expected_type: forall {tau : Ty} (t : Term tau), Term.Equiv t (Term.constFold t)

closure.algorithm: Independent Lean Expr recursive constant walker; FIFO breadth-first queue over every ConstantInfo.type and value? true, including opaque values; independently recomputed Python BFS fixed point.
closure.metric: Elaborated type/value Expr.constants graph; includes core/generated declarations, does not equate to filtered project-only benchmark dependencies or full module/kernel-rule closure.
closure.builtin_collectAxioms: Cross-check only; does not replace independent walker or decide missing coverage.

steps: lake build VerifiedCompiler (empty package manifest, no cache)
ascribe exact universal theorem type, audit actual root
compile all seven original Boundary.lean examples
original FalseControl.lean must fail with actual rfl/type error
admitted SorryControl.lean must compile, independent graph must reach sorryAx and reject
custom-axiom fixture must compile and independent audit must reject
total_verdict: PASS only if every required compile/type/boundary/control and closed graph audit succeeds. Tool/import/timeout failures are NOT_RUN/PARTIAL, never successful negative controls. No repeat of this round or deletion of failures.
independence: No author reproduce.py, Audit.lean or Closure.lean code/parsers/classifiers imported or reused. Original proof and specified positive/negative Lean fixtures are fixed inputs.
exposure: Public complete proof seen before round; no claim of novel autonomous proof search.
reproduction: Run verify.py --round-id NEW_ADMITTED_ROUND --attempt NEW_EMPTY_DIRECTORY only after a separately authorized fresh admission; default attempt-1 is exclusive and cannot be replayed.
exclusive_launch: Frozen protocol/round/budget identity; exact attempt-1 only; round RESEARCH_LAUNCH_EXCLUSIVE.json opened with x mode prevents replay under another attempt name.
bounded_cleanup: Each compile wait <=116 seconds minus spawn overhead and entire deadline remaining minus4; taskkill owned process tree timeout2, wait1, fallback kill/wait1; no next child if prior child remains. Reserve5 seconds before spawning.
